highlights.excerpt:
Introducing Personal Finance in Claude, in beta in the US.

Connect the accounts you choose, and Claude answers your money questions in everyday language, from your own balances and transactions. Access is read-only, and Claude can't move, manage, or invest your money.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
Claude 个人理财功能在美国进入测试。

连接你选择的账户后，Claude 用日常语言根据余额与交易回答钱相关问题。权限只读，不能转账、管理或投资。
highlights.name: Claude
highlights.text_zh: Claude 美国上线个人理财测试：只读账户数据，用白话答钱相关问题。

The model powered the Linux kernel research we announced yesterday, and security teams at companies like Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks, Calif, and

highlights.excerpt:
Images, upgraded—introducing ChatGPT Images 2.6.

Now with GIFs and reference images.

Plus, two new models are coming to the API with 50% faster image generation.

图像升级——推出 ChatGPT Images 2.6。

现支持 GIF 与参考图。

highlights.name: OpenAI
highlights.text_zh: ChatGPT Images 2.6 上线：支持 GIF 与参考图，API 图像生成提速约 50%。

highlights.excerpt:
Some news: I’m joining OpenAI to lead product management for Core Products!

I have a lot of respect for OpenAI for showing the world that scaling works, for bringing AI to over a billion people, and for believing great products are core to the mission.
highlights.excerpt_zh:
有个消息：我将加入 OpenAI，负责核心产品的产品管理！

我很敬佩 OpenAI：证明扩展有效、把 AI 带给超十亿人，并相信伟大产品是使命核心。
highlights.name: cat
highlights.text_zh: Cat Wu 加盟 OpenAI，负责核心产品 PM，将与 Tibo 等一起做可控智能体。

highlights.excerpt: You have to reach the point where your fear of dying mediocre outweighs your fear of looking like an idiot. The first version of anything you do will be embarrassing, that should be obvious, but too many people let that thought keep them the same for decades on end.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 你得走到这一步：对平庸死去的恐惧，大于怕自己像个傻瓜。任何事的第一版都会尴尬，这本该显而易见，但太多人让这个念头把他们困住几十年。
highlights.name: DAN KOE
highlights.text_zh: Dan Koe：对平庸死去的恐惧，必须大过怕出丑；第一版总会尴尬。

highlights.excerpt: Watching my sons learn to write has explained a lot about why good writing is rare. They're both convinced they have to produce bloated word salad when writing essays in school, and that if they wrote simply and clearly they'd get bad grades. The sad thing is they may be right.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 看儿子学写作，让我更明白好文章为何稀缺。他们都以为学校作文必须写臃肿的词沙拉，简洁清楚反而会低分。可悲的是他们可能是对的。
highlights.name: Paul Graham
highlights.text_zh: Paul Graham：孩子以为学校作文必须堆砌辞藻，简洁反而会低分。

highlights.excerpt: Today was the worst market decline since the last one you don’t remember or care about anymore.
highlights.excerpt_zh: 今天是自你已不记得、也不再在意的那次以来，最差的市场跌幅。
highlights.name: Morgan Housel
highlights.text_zh: Morgan Housel：今天是自你已不记得的那次以来最差的市场跌幅。

Meet Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, our updated video generation model from @GoogleDeepMind 🎬

Get stronger consistency, more creative control, and faster, more cost-effective video creation at scale:

⚡ Fast & 30% lower cost: Draft at 360p or 720p ($0.07/s) and upscale to 1080p or 4K

认识 Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash，来自 @GoogleDeepMind 的更新视频生成模型。

更强一致性、更多创意控制，以及更快速、更省成本的规模化视频创作：

⚡ 更快且成本约降 30%：以 360p 或 720p（$0.07/秒）打草稿，再升到 1080p 或 4K
highlights.name: Google
